title: Wise Words
subtitle: WITH MARCO REYES  ·  STORY NIGHT

segments.head: TONIGHT: LORETTA'S BINGO
segments.author: Wise Words
lines: Good evening, everyone.
I'm Marco Reyes, and this is Wise Words.
Tonight's story is about Loretta Haynes, sixty-six, from Wheeling, West Virginia.
For thirty-one years she worked a toll booth, wishing strangers a nice day.
But for two years, she couldn't say one word to Hal, the bingo caller.

segments.head: CHAPTER 1: THE FIRE HALL
segments.quote: Life shrinks or expands in proportion to one's courage.
segments.author: Anaïs Nin
lines: Every Friday at the fire hall, Loretta only ever said one word to him. Bingo.
Her sister Dot had a magnet on her fridge, from the writer Anaïs Nin:
Life shrinks or expands in proportion to one's courage.
Her life had shrunk to a bingo card and a remote.
So that Friday, she stayed late to help Hal stack chairs.

segments.head: CHAPTER 2: SHAKY KNEES
segments.quote: Courage is doing what you are afraid to do. There can be no courage unless you're scared.
segments.author: Eddie Rickenbacker
lines: She wanted to ask him to the spaghetti dinner. Her knees knocked like sneakers in a dryer.
She remembered her dad's hero, the fighter pilot Eddie Rickenbacker:
Courage is doing what you are afraid to do. There can be no courage unless you're scared.
She was plenty scared. So she asked.
Hal said yes before she finished the sentence.

segments.head: CHAPTER 3: THE MARINARA
segments.quote: Life is a tragedy when seen in close-up, but a comedy in long-shot.
segments.author: Charlie Chaplin
lines: The date was a disaster. New shoes, big blisters. Then a meatball landed on Hal's white shirt.
Her face went red as the sauce. Then she thought of Charlie Chaplin:
Life is a tragedy when seen in close-up, but a comedy in long-shot.
So she laughed. Hal laughed. The waiter brought a stack of napkins.

segments.head: CHAPTER 4: COLD FEET
segments.quote: To fear love is to fear life, and those who fear life are already three parts dead.
segments.author: Bertrand Russell
lines: Then the worry came. What if it ends? Am I too old for this?
She skipped bingo. Dot brought a book by Bertrand Russell, the British thinker:
To fear love is to fear life, and those who fear life are already three parts dead.
Three parts dead? She was sixty-six, not finished.
She grabbed her lucky dauber and drove to the fire hall.

segments.head: CHAPTER 5: SAME DIRECTION
segments.quote: Love does not consist in gazing at each other, but in looking outward together in the same direction.
segments.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
lines: Their dinners got quiet. Too much staring.
Hal, a retired pilot, quoted the French writer and pilot Antoine de Saint-Exupéry:
Love does not consist in gazing at each other, but in looking outward together in the same direction.
So they picked a direction. Hot soup for the seniors every bingo night.
He called the numbers. She ladled.

segments.head: CHAPTER 6: THE SNORT
segments.quote: The supreme happiness of life is the conviction that we are loved; loved for ourselves, or rather, loved in spite of ourselves.
segments.author: Victor Hugo
lines: One night, Loretta snorted like a goose at her own joke, and hid her face.
Hal smiled and quoted Victor Hugo:
The supreme happiness of life is the conviction that we are loved; loved for ourselves, or rather, loved in spite of ourselves.
Then he said, I love that snort. I noticed you two years ago, too.

segments.head: THAT'S TONIGHT'S STORY
segments.quote: Be brave. Ask anyway. Laugh at the mess. Don't fear love. Look the same way. Let yourself be loved.
segments.author: Marco Reyes
lines: That's tonight's story.
Let your life grow. Ask, even scared. Laugh at the mess. Don't fear love. Look the same way. Let yourself be loved.
I asked a lady to dance once. I've been apologizing to her feet ever since.
I'm Marco Reyes. Good night.
